snippet.title: ►Wretch (Game Teaser) - Horror Mystery In Abandoned High School
snippet.description:
Scour the abandoned corridors of Tasselwood High School. A routine check in the middle of the night turns in to a fatal game of cat-and-mouse.

Add Wretch to your Steam Wishlist now:
🔶 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216280/Wretch/

Uncover the mysteries:

▪️Why was the school sealed off in such haste?
▪️What is Project Luminaire?
▪️Who killed Bethany Carlington?
▪️And who’s waiting for you in the halls that should’ve been empty?

This teaser highlights Wretch’s suspenseful atmosphere, environmental storytelling, and the creeping dread that defines this indie psychological horror experience.

🔶 Follow for updates & behind-the-scenes content:
https://x.com/WretchTheGame
